title: Now Is the Month of Maying
description: Thomas Morley's 1595 ballett, for 2 to 4 singers: verse 1 and its "fa la" refrains, each half sung twice, as Morley's own parts with his two tenors joined into one. Light and dancing, every voice with a tune of its own.

credits.arrangement: Thomas Morley (1595), his five voices as four for Stackapella (draft)

licence.arrangement: Morley's own parts, public domain; joining the two tenors is original, written for Stackapella
licence.source: all five voices from E. H. Fellowes, The English Madrigal School, vol. IV (Stainer & Bell, 1913; Fellowes died 1951), No. 3, pp. 8 to 10, its accidentals checked against the 1595 part-books; read from the scans at imslp.org (The English Madrigal School, first edition) and archive.org
